Coram : VIKRAM NATH*, AHSANUDDIN AMANULLAH
Issue for Consideration Whether the suit land was under any sort of legal encumbrance so as to make it unfit for transfer of right, title and interest thereon in light of the Layout Plan notified by the Deputy Director, Town and Country Planning, Thanjavur region in the revised in the year 1981. Headnotes† Tamil Nadu Town and Country Planning Act, 1972 – ss.37 and 38 – For a creation of a Nagar various plots were formed by one N – In a Layout plan, a portion of land was earmarked for public purpose for welfare of the residents –
Decision Date : 28-08-2024 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5875/2023 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
